'''Trandosite decks''' are the constructed lists published on [[Trandosite]] (trandosite.mcmail.com), [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site, as indexed from its Decks page.<ref name="idx">[http://trandosite.mcmail.com/decks.htm Decks Section], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050405090633/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/decks.htm Internet Archive]</ref> Each list cites its Wayback copy. Date is the year of the Wayback capture used. Format is the smallest format that fits the card pool. Lists with unmatched cards or a total other than 60 are marked partial.

Event decks use the event title. They are linked from [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[2000 Coventry Grand Slam]] and [[2000 UK National Championship]].

A parent index of all published 60s is [[Decklists]].
